note: Static semantic-source map, immutable per adapter id. Keys are exactly tools/repository_evidence.COMPARABILITY_CHECKED_FIELDS. Its sha256 is pinned in tools/org083_coverage_adapter.py; any edit without a new adapter id is refusal R17a. `facts` are the machine-readable declarations that observed values are contradiction-checked against (R17c).

collector.tool_version.statement: 7.17.0, binary wheels only (cp311 and cp312 manylinux x86_64), sha256 per interpreter from the hash lock; the pure-Python wheel is forbidden

collector.command_fingerprint.statement: sha256 of canonical JSON over the placeholderized argv template of section 6, the env allowlist values, the exact sorted union of unset variable names plus the redirect-rule name, the PATH-resolved python3 identity and -n; no junit node-id set

collector.config_digest.statement: sha256 over canonical {coverage_config_bytes_sha256, pins}; static inputs only, no resolved map and no tool output

collector.runner_fingerprint.statement: runner identity: python implementation and exact version, platform and glibc, runner label, cpu count, effective core and CTracer availability, sha256 of the sorted lower-cased pip freeze

scope.scope_fingerprint.statement: sha256 over canonical {include_selectors, omit_patterns, exclusion_record_ids, exclusion_regexes, discovery_rule, in_scope_paths, unreported_scope_paths}; no blob shas, no contents, no pragma inventory

denominator.statement: line: totals.num_statements; branch: totals.num_branches (coverage json format 3)

branch_semantics.statement: coverage.py arc destinations under the ctrace core: static-analysis possible transitions vs measured (source, destination) pairs; coverage default branch exclusions only

function_semantics.statement: deferred: no function-hit numerator/denominator; per-function regions retained only

test_selection.statement: selection rule: argv tools/, no -k/-m/--deselect/--ignore, no -p no:<plugin> beyond cacheprovider, env allowlist of section 7; the executed node-id set is an observation, not part of this declaration
